pool.text: The Aceh Sultanate under Gocah Pahlawan expanded its territory to include Medan.
Perunggit declared the Deli Sultanate, including Medan, independent of the Aceh Sultanate.
De Deli Maatschappij moved its head office from Labuhan Deli to Medan.
Sultan Ma'mun Al Rashid Perkasa Alamyah finished the construction of the Maimun Palace.
Aeint Herman de Boer built Hotel de Boer to accommodate European tourists visiting Medan.
Sultan Ma'mun Al Rashid Perkasa Alamyah built the Great Mosque of Medan.
Japanese forces entered Medan on bicycles and occupied the city during a campaign.
The Japanese occupation of Medan ended with their surrender in this year.
Allied forces regained control of Medan in April of this year.
The Dutch established the State of East Sumatra with Medan as its capital.
The State of East Sumatra was dissolved into the Republic of Indonesia.
Brigade General Leo Lopulisa opened the Bukit Barisan Museum on 21 June.
Daoed Joesoef formally opened the North Sumatra Museum south of the city center.
Medan established a twinning relationship with George Town in Malaysia on October 10.
A major port restructuring saw the construction of a container terminal in Medan.
Medan formed a twinning agreement with Ichikawa in Chiba Prefecture on November 4.
Medan became twinned with Gwangju in South Korea on September 24.
Student demonstrations turned into riots in Medan after a student died in a clash.
The Rahmat International Wildlife Museum & Gallery opened as an outstanding taxidermy collection.
Medan established a twinning partnership with Chengdu in China on December 17.
